item.title: Mumford & Sons Announce 2026 Australia & New Zealand Prizefighter Tour With Folk Bitch Trio
item.description: Mumford & Sons will bring their 2026 Prizefighter Tour to Melbourne, Sydney and Auckland next April and May, joined by Folk Bitch Trio. Tickets on sale 5 December.

item.title: Triple J Launches New Country Club Show As Unearthed Celebrates Australia’s Country Boom
item.description: Tom Forrest will lead triple j’s new 2026 program Country Club, as the network expands its focus on Australia’s growing country music movement.

item.title: Earth, Wind & Fire To Return To Australia In April 2026 For First Shows In 14 Years
item.description: Earth, Wind & Fire will return to Australia in April 2026 for their first local shows since 2012, including a Bluesfest headline set and two exclusive theatre performances.

item.title: Sean Ono Lennon Brings Oscar-Winning War Is Over! To YouTube For Global Charity Premiere
item.description: Sean Ono Lennon will premiere the Oscar winning animated short War Is Over! on YouTube on 1 December, raising funds for War Child and reviving the message of Happy Xmas (War Is Over).

item.title: Colin Hay Postpones Australian Shows Due To Covid
item.description: Colin Hay has postponed his December Australian shows due to serious respiratory complications from the flu and Covid. Affected shows include Melbourne Recital Centre, Enmore Theatre and Meredith Festival. All dates are rescheduled for June 2026.

item.title: Opeth Mark One Year Of The Last Will And Testament With New Animated Film For §3
item.description: Opeth have released a new animated video for §3 to celebrate the first anniversary of The Last Will And Testament, expanding the album’s conceptual narrative.

item.title: Sean Combs Moves To Block Netflix Release Of New Documentary
item.description: Sean Combs has issued a cease-and-desist to Netflix in an attempt to stop the release of Sean Combs, The Reckoning, alleging the documentary contains stolen and unauthorised footage. Netflix denies the claims and will proceed with the launch.

item.title: Radiohead Postpone First Two Copenhagen Shows As Thom Yorke Battles Severe Throat Infection
item.description: Radiohead have postponed the first two shows of their Copenhagen residency after Thom Yorke was diagnosed with a severe throat infection. New dates have been set for 15 and 16 December.

item.title: Handa Opera on Sydney Harbour Returns With The Phantom of the Opera for 2026
item.description: The Phantom Of The Opera returns to Sydney Harbour for a limited season, with live orchestra, fireworks and new large scale staging.

item.title: King Stingray Return To Headline The Gum Ball’s 21st Year
item.description: King Stingray return to headline The Gum Ball in 2026, with Meg Washington, Don Walker and more confirmed for the festival’s first line-up announcement.
